items.item_text: Clinical license preferred.
BA in business, a clinical field such as social work or nursing, public health, or related area required.
Masters Degree preferred
Minimum ten (10) or more years of leadership experience in healthcare care delivery operations is required.

Demonstrated experience and success in care delivery operations in Medicare Managed Care, including network development and contracting, quality oversight, and population health management/care coordination programs.
Lead, manage, develop and coordinate the KP senior care delivery strategy and care delivery operations.
Work closely with all national, shared service and local market leaders ensuring access, quality, and regulatory compliance for the delivery of care to our Medicare members.

Directly manage designated Medicare leaders who are responsible for the national approach to the senior care delivery operations. Lead, manage, mentor, and develop Medicare care delivery leaders across KP to provide subject matter expertise to the markets and identified shared services with implementation of Medicare care delivery.

In partnership with clinical leaders, physician leaders, and the national Medicare LOB, innovate and leverage new care models that deliver better quality, experience and efficiency. Work closely with KPIT to leverage digital tools that enable the delivery of those care models.

Lead implementation of Medicare care delivery regulatory requirements in collaboration with the Medicare LOB and regulatory services. Partner with market operations to ensure systems and processes ensure the delivery of quality care.

In partnership with the Health Plan Medicare LOB, coordinate Senior Advisory Committees (SAC) to ensure engagement and representation of KP members and stakeholders in the ongoing development and implementation of the senior care strategy.

In partnership with the Health Plan Medicare LOB, government relations, and legal, maintain a deep understanding of current and potential state and Federal Medicare related legislation and regulations, and their impact on KP Medicare strategy, care delivery operations, and performance.
Coordinate and align market Medicare care delivery strategy development and implementation across the markets and the national Medicare line of business.
Establish, modify and monitor a comprehensive set of key performance metrics across all functions to drive and monitor Medicare care delivery performance.
Collaborate with regional and national finance, including Medicare and Medicaid finance, to drive, monitor, track and trend financial performance.
Develop and implement care delivery initiatives to improve the care experience and financial performance of the Medicare line of business.
Sponsor, lead, manage or participate in initiatives that are crucial to KP participation in Medicare and may also impact other business lines.
Understanding of Kaiser Permanente and the integrated health plan and care delivery models.
Demonstrated competencies in care delivery operations, strategy, finance, operational planning and program management.
Extensive knowledge and expertise in Medicare.
Ability to lead in a highly matrixed organization, including the ability to lead and collaborate effectively through influence and relationship, rather than through reporting relationships.
